CAREER GUIDANCE ACADEMY (C.G.A)

Comprehensive System Architecture & Detailed Project Overview
📍 Chanban Youth Club Rd, behind Youth Club, Udaipur, Tripura 799114
Academic Platform v2.0
Stack: Next.js 16 + Supabase
Date: October 2026
Executive Summary
Career Guidance Academy (C.G.A) is an enterprise-grade coaching institute web platform and Learning Management System (LMS) specifically tailored for competitive examination aspirants and school students in Tripura. The platform seamlessly integrates a public discovery portal, an authenticated student learning environment, and a robust institute management and CMS console.

1. Project Scope & Coaching Divisions

The academy caters to four major academic categories, each with tailored curricula, mock test series, and learning materials:

1. Teaching & State Recruitment Exams

Comprehensive preparation for Tripura education and recruitment boards:

Tripura TET Paper I & II STGT (Secondary Teachers) STPGT (Post Graduate) TPSC (Combined / Departmental) JRBT Group C & D
2. Banking, SSC & Railway Exams

National level competitive examinations training:

IBPS PO & Clerk SBI PO & Junior Associates SSC CGL / CHSL / MTS RRB NTPC & Group D
3. Other Competitive Examinations

Specialized defense and higher education entrance programs:

Tripura Police SI & Constable Defence Forces Recruitment CUET (UG Entrance)
4. School Foundation Coaching (Class VII to X)

Board-specific academic foundation coaching:

TBSE Class VII, VIII, IX, X CBSE Class VII, VIII, IX, X Dedicated Board Batches

2. Technical Architecture & Stack

Layer Technology Role in Application
Frontend Framework Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5 Server-side rendering, nested layouts, rapid initial loads, and edge optimization.
Styling & Design System Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons Custom academic palette (Navy #0A0E2A, Royal Blue #0056B3, Torch Orange #EA580C), responsive grids, and clean cards.
Database & RLS Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security Multi-tenant data isolation, strict authorization policies, sequences, triggers, and automated cascade scripts.
Authentication Supabase Auth (@supabase/ssr) Session cookies, role metadata (student vs admin), email verification, and password recovery.
Document Engine pdf-parse & Custom RegEx Ingestion Automated extraction of questions, options (A to D), answer keys, and explanations from uploaded PDF question papers.
State & Cache Layer React Context (CgaContext) & Service Layer Optimistic UI updates, in-app toast notices, reactive student session synchronization, and hybrid seed fallbacks.

3. Core Environments & Features

A. Public Web Portal (Open Access)

  • Homepage (/): Hero banner with institute mission, 4-division coaching directory, featured courses, faculty highlights, student testimonials, and direct enquiry modal.
  • Course Catalogue (/courses): Advanced search and multi-facet filtering (Category, Mode: Online/Offline, Status: Open for Admission / Batch Closed, and Board: TBSE vs CBSE).
  • Achievements (/achievements): Board toppers and state rank-holders gallery filterable by exam category with scores and testimonial quotes.
  • Faculty Directory (/faculty): Subject mentor profiles with designations, academic credentials, teaching experience, and specializations.
  • About Us & Contact (/about, /contact): Campus history, director's address, embedded Udaipur Google Maps, phone, email, and validated admission inquiry form that records into the database.
  • Authentication Flows (/login, /register, /forgot-password): Tabbed sign-in, self-registration generating sequential ID CGA-YYYY-XXX, and secure password recovery.

B. Student Learning Portal (/student/*)

  • Student Dashboard (/student/dashboard): Welcome banner, active enrolled course cards with syllabus progress meters, scheduled upcoming tests, and fee dues status.
  • Course Self-Enrolment (/student/courses): Choose between Full Payment or 2-Part Instalment Plan, complete simulated checkout, auto-decrement available batch seats, download instant official fee receipt, or join waiting list when full.
  • My Courses (/student/my-courses): Batch timings, assigned faculty mentor, syllabus completion tracker, and shortcuts to associated materials and tests.
  • Study Materials Library (/student/materials): Gated soft-copy PDFs and paid notes unlocked only for enrolled batches. Includes an In-Browser Anti-Piracy Watermarked Reader that overlays the student's name, ID, and timestamp across pages.
  • Mock Tests Arena (/student/tests): Timed Computer-Based Test (CBT) engine featuring:
    • Real-time countdown timer, question palette (Answered, Unanswered, Marked for Review).
    • Formula-based negative marking calculation.
    • Exam Integrity: Faculty solutions and answer keys remain strictly locked while taking the test.
    • Instant scorecard with batch merit rank, accuracy percentage, and full question explanations unlocked upon submission.
  • Fee Ledger & Receipts (/student/fees): Comprehensive breakdown of total course fee, paid amount, pending balance, instalment clearance flow, and printable official receipts.

C. Institute Administrator & CMS Console (/admin/*)

  • Executive KPI Dashboard (/admin/dashboard): Total student enrollment, active courses, total institute revenue, outstanding fee dues, and visual division seat-occupancy charts.
  • Student Management (/admin/students): Search and filter student directory, 360° student modal (enrolled courses, fee transactions, test attempts), export roster to CSV/Excel, and generate temporary sign-in credentials.
  • Atomic Candidate Purge (Cascade Deletion): Admin ability to permanently scrub any candidate across test_attempts, fee_payments, enrollments, waiting_list, profiles, and auth.users in a single safe atomic operation.
  • Course & Batch Control (/admin/courses): Create and edit courses, adjust fee schedules, and open/close admissions in real-time.
  • Automated PDF Test Ingestion (/admin/tests): Upload PDF/text question papers; intelligent parser extracts 50–100 questions, choices (A–D), answer keys, and explanations with one-click key modifications before publishing.
  • Fee Management & Defaulter Tracking (/admin/fees): Record counter cash/UPI payments, issue receipts, and filter fee defaulters by batch.
  • Content Management System: Dedicated management interfaces for Study Materials (/admin/materials), Faculty (/admin/faculty), Achievements (/admin/achievements), Announcements (/admin/announcements), and Live Site Content (/admin/site-content).

4. Database Schema & Relational Design

Table Name Keys & Relationships Core Attributes & Responsibilities
profiles id (UUID PK → auth.users) role ('student'|'admin'), student_code (Unique 'CGA-2026-XXX'), name, email, phone, guardian_name, qualification, target_exam, status ('Active'|'Inactive').
courses id (Text PK), faculty_id (FK) name, category, mode ('Online'|'Offline'), board (TBSE/CBSE), class_level, price, first_instalment, batch_name, batch_size, seats_available, waiting_list_count, status ('Open for Admission'|'Batch Closed').
faculty id (Text PK) name, designation, subject, qualification, experience, photo, bio, specialization_tags.
enrollments id (UUID PK), student_id, course_id enrolled_date, progress (0–100%), total_fee, paid_amount, due_amount, next_due_date. Unique constraint on (student_id, course_id).
fee_payments id (UUID PK), receipt_no (UK) student_id, course_id, amount, payment_mode (UPI, Card, Net Banking, Cash), payment_type (Full Payment, Instalment 1/2, Balance Clearance), date, remarks.
mock_tests id (Text PK), course_id (FK) title, batch_name, duration_minutes, total_marks, marks_per_question, negative_marking, status ('Published'|'Draft'), questions (JSONB array with answer keys & explanations).
test_attempts id (UUID PK), test_id, student_id score, total_marks, correct_count, wrong_count, unattempted_count, accuracy, time_taken_minutes, submitted_at, answers (JSONB submitted choices).
study_materials id (Text PK), course_id (FK) title, type ('Book PDF'|'Paid Notes'), author, pages, file_size, preview_sections (JSONB), uploaded_date.
announcements id (Text PK) title, content, target_batch ('All Batches' or specific batch), priority ('Normal'|'Important'|'Urgent'), date, author.
enquiries id (UUID PK) name, phone, email, course_interest, message, created_at.
waiting_list (student_id, course_id) Composite PK Auto-queued students when course seats are exhausted.
site_content id (Int PK = 1) CMS-managed JSONB storing hero banners, institute mission/vision, and contact phone/address.

5. Security, Row Level Security (RLS) & RPCs

Row Level Security (RLS) Policies
  • Public: Read-only access to published courses, faculty, achievements, and CMS site content. Can insert public inquiries.
  • Students: Strictly restricted to their own profiles, their own enrollment records, unlocked course materials, fee ledger, and test scores.
  • Admins: Evaluated through Postgres role checks and authenticated via the Supabase Service Role Key on backend server actions.
Transactional Stored Procedures (RPCs)
  • submit_mock_test_attempt(): Server-authoritative calculation of test scores, negative markings, accuracy, and attempt records.
  • enrol_student(): Atomically records enrollment, creates payment receipt, and decrements batch seats within a single transaction.
  • purge_candidate(): Admin cascade that purges all student records across five tables plus authentication credentials.

6. Unique Architectural Innovations

1. Bulk AI / RegEx Question Ingestion

Parses complex question formats: numbered questions (1., Q1.), option choices ((A)–(D), A)–D)), inline answer keys (Ans: B), and separate bottom answer tables. Eliminates hours of manual data entry.

2. Dynamic Document Watermarking

Watermarks PDF study notes in real-time with the active student's name, roll code, and timestamp, effectively preventing study material piracy.
